title: Pure Ryu-Ge
summary: Ryu-Ge cards only, with generic Rank 10s in the Extra Deck and generic staples. Ryu-Ge War Zone distributes the Dinosaur, Sea Serpent, and Wyrm Level 10 Ryu-Ge into the hand, GY, and banishment so all three can summon themselves alongside the Ritual Pendulum boss Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ryu-Ge Rising searches a Dinosaur, Sea Serpent, or Wyrm Ryu-Ge monster from the Deck, then can add a Ryu-Ge Pendulum Monster to the face-up Extra Deck.
Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva activates in the Pendulum Scale to search a non-Pendulum Ryu-Ge card (such as Ryu-Ge War Zone) and destroys itself to go face-up to the Extra Deck.
Kyoro Ryu-Ge Kaiva, Kairo Ryu-Ge Emva, and Genro Ryu-Ge Hakva each shuffle themselves from the hand into the Deck to search their matching Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spell.

summary.title: Opening: Ryu-Ge Rising or Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva
steps: Place Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva in the Pendulum Zone and use its Pendulum Effect to search Ryu-Ge War Zone and destroy Mistva face-up to the Extra Deck.
Activate Ryu-Ge War Zone to take Kyoro Ryu-Ge Kaiva (Dinosaur), Kairo Ryu-Ge Emva (Sea Serpent), and Genro Ryu-Ge Hakva (Wyrm) from the Deck: add one to your hand, send one to the GY, and banish one.

Trigger their self-summon conditions—and when a monster is destroyed, Tribute a Ryu-Ge monster to Ritual Summon Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva from the face-up Extra Deck and place up to three Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spells on your field.

summary.title: Three Realms & Level 10 Triggers
summary.text: Each Level 10 Ryu-Ge enters the field from the zone War Zone placed it in: Kaiva summons itself from the hand after two monsters are destroyed, Emva revives itself from the GY when a card is sent from the hand or Deck to the GY, and Hakva summons itself from banishment when two monsters are banished. Once on the field, they return their matching Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spell to the bottom of the Deck as a Quick Effect to negate a monster (Dino Domains), bounce a card (Sea Spires), or zero a monster's ATK (Wyrm Winds)—and Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva can fire all three Realm effects itself.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva Ritual Summons itself from the hand or face-up Extra Deck whenever a monster is destroyed, destroys cards on summon, and places up to three Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spells from the Deck.
Tensei Ryu-Ge Anva Tributes a Ryu-Ge to Special Summon itself and destroy a card on the field, and in the Pendulum Zone it negates opponent responses to your Ryu-Ge Spells.

Skypalace Gangaridai overlays two Level 10 Ryu-Ge monsters to destroy a card the opponent controls and inflict 1000 damage (Varudras, the Final Bringer of the End Times is Forbidden since October 2026).

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ryu-Ge Rivalry Special Summons a Ryu-Ge from the hand, Deck, or GY and recycles a Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spell to draw a card.
Ryu-Ge End prevents your Ryu-Ge monsters from being targeted by the opponent's monster effects and shuffles two banished Ryu-Ge cards into the Deck to destroy a monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Swordsoul, Dinomorphia, and Yubel partner engines are omitted to keep this build pure Ryu-Ge.
